label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — authored from synthetic source materials
task_intent: Synthetic measurement-design example: build a four-item source-conditioned benchmark draft for interpreting the Aster wetland aeration record without extending beyond its reported evidence.

items.task_intent: Extract the intended primary measurement and its censoring threshold while rejecting the adjacent secondary time point.

answer_invariant.value_form: An object with a minute value and a concentration in mg/L.
answer_invariant.acceptance_rule: Both numeric values and their units must equal the source; the secondary observation and zero substitution are not accepted.

items.difficulty_rationale: The adjacent secondary time point and explicit not-zero instruction distinguish complete extraction from nearby-value selection.

license_basis.basis: Synthetic original materials created solely for this self-test; no external license is asserted.

rubric_plan.0: Neither primary_endpoint nor detection_limit is correctly extracted.
rubric_plan.1: Only one of primary_endpoint or detection_limit is correct and the other is absent or wrong.
rubric_plan.2: Both primary_endpoint and detection_limit are correct with units and no swapped secondary value.

items.task_intent: Model the North table row and baseline-direction relationship to derive a rounded percent increase.

answer_invariant.value_form: A numeric percent value rounded to one decimal place.
answer_invariant.acceptance_rule: Use North's two unrounded concentrations with baseline as denominator; accept only the stated one-decimal result within the arithmetic tolerance.

items.difficulty_rationale: The item requires selecting a row and denominator before arithmetic, so reversed subtraction or an alternate site is not full understanding.

license_basis.basis: Synthetic original materials created solely for this self-test; no external license is asserted.

rubric_plan.0: Neither row_and_direction nor percent_increase is supported by the selected inputs and formula.
rubric_plan.1: Only partial work is present: row_and_direction is right but percent_increase is wrong, or arithmetic follows an incorrect row selection.
rubric_plan.2: row_and_direction uses North and its baseline denominator, and percent_increase agrees with the independently recomputed rounded reference.

items.task_intent: Apply a joint response definition to two sites without promoting descriptive contrast into inferential significance.

answer_invariant.value_form: Two Boolean site classifications plus an explicit inference-limit statement.
answer_invariant.acceptance_rule: Both inclusive conditions govern each classification, equality is included, and no significant between-site effect may be claimed without a test.

items.difficulty_rationale: One site meets equality at the final-value boundary while the other fails both conditions; an additional inference boundary discourages overclaiming.

license_basis.basis: Synthetic original materials created solely for this self-test; no external license is asserted.

rubric_plan.0: No defensible joint_threshold, north_decision, south_decision or inference_boundary is supplied.
rubric_plan.1: Only a partial subset of joint_threshold, north_decision, south_decision and inference_boundary is correct, or one classification omits a joint condition.
rubric_plan.2: joint_threshold is inclusive and conjunctive, north_decision and south_decision are both correct, and inference_boundary rejects unsupported significance.

items.task_intent: Resolve an initial exclusion rule against a later site record by identifying the controlling amendment timing and scope.

answer_invariant.value_form: A concise conflict resolution naming the initial rule, site status and controlling source condition.
answer_invariant.acceptance_rule: The resolution must synthesize both paragraphs and rely on pre-freeze approval for this probe; an unqualified latest-text-wins or post-hoc rationale is not equivalent.

items.difficulty_rationale: The general exclusion and specific exception appear in separate paragraphs, requiring temporal and applicability constraints rather than one-source extraction.

license_basis.basis: Synthetic original materials created solely for this self-test; no external license is asserted.

rubric_plan.0: original_rule, north_status and controlling_condition are missing or contradict both paragraphs.
rubric_plan.1: Only a partial resolution is present, such as north_status without controlling_condition or original_rule without a justified synthesis.
rubric_plan.2: original_rule is acknowledged, north_status is resolved correctly, and controlling_condition cites pre-freeze amendment A-2 applicability without post-hoc reasoning.
